$: Version-bearing files for Snatch, enumerated once here rather than rediscovered under release pressure (releases.md section 1). Consumed by the cut-release skill. Adding a version surface means adding it BOTH to files[] below and to scripts/check-version-drift.sh, which is what proves the bump reached everything.

files.$: The single source of truth. app.py imports __version__ from here for the window title, and the About text reads the same value, so nothing else needs a copy.
macOS bundle metadata. Two keys, both carrying the plain triple; Finder shows the first and the second is what an upgrade compares.

$todos: The changelog cut is a todo rather than the author's step because changelog_log op:"release" performs it mechanically -- it closes [Unreleased] into the dated section and opens a fresh empty one, moving text that already exists rather than authoring any. cut-release recognises that op as the recipe performing the cut, and hands the section check to post_check, which is why check-version-drift.sh asserts the section too.
todos: changelog_log op:"release" version:"{NEW}" date:"{TODAY}" caller_cwd:<project root> -- closes [Unreleased] into ## [{NEW}] - {TODAY} and opens a fresh empty [Unreleased] above it
